acquisition_method: The Q-Exactive was operated in a data-dependent mode
alkylation_concentration: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT and 15 μg of iodoacetamide
alkylation_reagent: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT and 15 μg of iodoacetamide
cleavage_agent: Three micrograms of LysC was added to each sample and incubated for 3 h at room temperature. Subsequently, samples were diluted with 4 volumes of Digestion Buffer (50 mM NH4HCO3) and trypsin (Promega) was added at a ratio of 1:50.
collision_energy: by HCD (resolution 17,500, AGC target 1E5, maximum injection time 60 ms, NCE 28)
fractionation_method: Peptides from each biological replicate were then subjected to high pH reverse-phase (RP) fractionation on an Agilent 1100 HPLC system
fragmentation_method: by HCD (resolution 17,500, AGC target 1E5, maximum injection time 60 ms, NCE 28)
instrument: Purified peptides were analyzed using an Easy nano LC 1000 nanoflow HPLC (Thermo Fisher) on-line coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
ionization_type: inferred: The Q-Exactive was operated in a data-dependent mode using Xcalibur v.2.2 (Thermo Fisher) and set to acquire a full-range scan at 70,000 resolution from 350 to 2000 Th
labeling: For SILAC experiments, cells were stimulated in the appropriate SILAC-formulated media.
mass_analyzer: inferred: Purified peptides were analyzed using an Easy nano LC 1000 nanoflow HPLC (Thermo Fisher) on-line coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
ptm: carbamidomethyl, methionine oxidation, deamidation (NQ), N-acetylation (protein N-terminus)
fixed modifications, carbamidomethyl; variable modifications, methionine oxidation, deamidation (NQ), and N-acetylation (protein N-terminus)
reduction_concentration: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT and 15 μg of iodoacetamide
reduction_reagent: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT and 15 μg of iodoacetamide
